title: Preposizioni di movimento e indicazioni
rule: to, into, out of, along, across, past, through, up, down, over, under, around, towards, from…to. Con go, walk, run, drive, take, get. Alcune destinazioni vanno senza to: home, downtown, upstairs, here, there.

head: Preposizione
Italiano
Esempio
rows: go to work, walk to the station, the train to Montréal
go into the station, get into the car
come out of the subway, get out of the taxi
walk along the street, drive along the lake
walk across the road, swim across the lake
go past the bank, walk past the park
walk through the park, go through the tunnel
go up the stairs, walk down Yonge Street
go over the bridge, jump over the fence
walk around the block, drive around the city
get off the bus, step onto the platform

head: Italiano
Nota
rows: bus, streetcar, subway, train, plane, bike
get to work, get to the station · ma get home, get there
go back = tornare là; come back = tornare qui
I'll pick you up at six.

blocks.caption: Senza to
head: Esempio
rows: go home, get home, come home, walk home
come here, go there, go abroad

items.wrong: go to home, go to downtown, come to here
items.right: go home, go downtown, come here

items.wrong: enter in the room, exit from the bus
items.right: go into the room / enter the room, get off the bus
items.why: Enter senza preposizione; i mezzi con get on / off.

items.right: arrive in Toronto / get to Toronto
items.why: Arrive in (città, paese), arrive at (luogo preciso).

items.right: walk across the street / walk along the street
items.why: Across per attraversare, along per percorrere.

items.q: Walk ___ the park, ___ the bridge, and ___ the river. (attraverso · sopra · lungo)
items.n: Attraversa il parco, passa sul ponte e cammina lungo il fiume.

items.q: Get ___ the taxi, get ___ the bus, and go ___.
items.n: Scendi dal taxi, sali sull'autobus e vai a casa.

options: We get to Toronto at six.
We arrive to Toronto at six.
We get in Toronto at six.
items.why: Get to + luogo (o arrive in Toronto).
